messages:
Leah Park: Quick RFC follow-up: instead of LeaseTokens or full sticky pins, I'm proposing an adaptive 'reserve_hint' primitive. API: reserve_hint(key, intent=\"hot\"|\"warm\", ttl_ms=?, weight=1) + release_hint(key). Hints don't guarantee residency but bias eviction.

Ibrahim Noor: Love the smaller surface. Main questions: how do we translate weight+intent into eviction priority, and how do we prevent hint spam from starving other tenants?

Juno Kim: Implementation sketch: map intent+weight -> score = base(intent) * weight; evictor orders by score/last_access_age. Add a per-tenant hint_budget that decays (token-bucket) so abuse is rate-limited.

Leah Park: Also propose an adaptive demote curve: demote probability = sigmoid((tenant_frag - frag_threshold) * k) * age_factor. This makes demotion more aggressive as frag rises.

Ibrahim Noor: For operators, we need a single signal: frag_entropy. It combines free-chunk-distribution + avg-run-length. Alert when frag_entropy > 0.6. Expose tenant-level heatmap (/api/telemetry/frag_heatmap?tenant=...).

Juno Kim: Microbench notes from prototype w/ reserve_hint + token-bucket:
```
mixed-bursty replay
median latency: +2%
p95: +7%
recompute tokens: -22%
frag_entropy: down 8% w/ incremental coalesce
```
Incremental coalesce + compact-on-idle helped tails; full compaction still too disruptive.

Leah Park: Rollout plan: land hint API behind FF disabled by default; enable incremental coalesce on background worker; start canary 0.5% traffic; run chaos where many tenants call reserve_hint to validate rate limits.

ops-bot: feature-flag memory.reserve_hint created. canary scheduled (id: canary-2026-07-21-02). Dashboards: /d/memory/reserve-hint (owner: @Leah).

Ibrahim Noor: Action items: Juno add tenant_heatmap endpoint + frag_entropy metric, I'll add hint_budget enforcement in admission path, Leah draft SDK guidance with sample backoff and hint hygiene.

Juno Kim: Will add suggested default params: ttl_ms=120000, intent=\"warm\", weight=1, and a conservative hint_budget (5 hints/min by default). Also include an opt-in pin-like API for model-serving partners (higher quota after approval).

Leah Park: Keep pin-like API off in initial canary. Let's reconvene after sims; please paste sims + dashboards here. :+1:

Ibrahim Noor: +1

Juno Kim: :thumbsup:
